title: Whales and dolphins
examples: Do whales eat fish or plants?
What makes a whale different from a fish?
How big can the largest whale get?

explain.say: Whales and dolphins are mammals that live in the sea.
Like you, they need to breathe air.
They breathe through a blowhole. It is an opening on top of their head.
They swim deep down to find food. Then they come up to breathe.
A dolphin comes up to the surface. It blows out air through its blowhole.
Sometimes a whale leaps right out of the water. This is called breaching.

faq.q: Do whales breathe air or water?
faq.a: Whales and dolphins are mammals, so they must breathe air. They use their blowholes to breathe the air we breathe.

faq.q: What is the blowhole used for?
faq.a: The blowhole is the special opening they use to breathe air from the surface. It is located on top of their head.
asks: What is that hole on top?

faq.a: Whales are warm-blooded, which means they keep their own body temperature warm. This is a key sign that they are mammals.
asks: Do they get warm from the sun?
Are they like fish or like us?

faq.a: Some whales dive very deep to find food. They hold their breath while they dive.
asks: How long can they stay underwater?
What do they do when they dive deep?

faq.a: No, sea mammals also include manatees and sea otters. Whales and dolphins are just two types of them.
asks: What else lives in the ocean like them?

facts: Whales and dolphins are mammals, meaning they breathe air.
They use a blowhole, which is an opening on their head.
Because they are warm-blooded, they keep their bodies warm.
They must surface regularly to breathe air.

quiz.say: Whales are mammals. What do they come up to the surface to breathe?
quiz.why: Whales are mammals. They breathe air with their lungs.

wrong.0: Fish take oxygen from water, but whales breathe air.
wrong.2: Seaweed is a plant, and nothing breathes it.

quiz.why: A blowhole is an opening on top of a whale's head.

wrong.0: Fish have gills, and whales breathe air.

quiz.say: Whales are warm-blooded. What does that mean?

options.show: it keeps its own body warm
options.say: it keeps its own body warm

options.show: it lives only in warm water
options.say: it lives only in warm water

quiz.why: A warm-blooded animal keeps its own body warm, like you do.

wrong.1: Many whales swim in icy seas and stay warm inside.
wrong.2: Warm-blooded is about the body, and it says nothing about food.
